To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the production rate of charmonium at the Tevatron is dominated by the fragmentation of high-pT parton pairs and that (2) this fragmentation process is described by the color-octet formalism of NRQCD.

the rate of prompt char monium production in hadron collisions at high transverse momentum is dominated by the fragmentation of high-pT part ons into color-octet quarkonium states, which then form color-singlet quarkonia through a mechanism that is similar to the one that is responsible for the production of heavy quarks.

the dominant production mechanisms at high transverse momentum are the gluon fragmentation into color-octet cc¯ and the cc¯ pair annihilation to a color-octet state followed by the fragmentation of that color-octet into charmonium.
